newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Jan 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien, together with his country's ten provincial premiers, other top officials and businessmen, will arrive today for a three-day official visit aimed at strengthening relations with the Philippines. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- President Ramos dared yesterday critics of the national identification system to impeach him, claiming opposition to the scheme would not prosper. (STAR/TIMES/MALAYA/TODAY)
- The Philippine National Police has placed under watch about 70 congressmen as part of the hunt for Representative Romeo Jalosjos. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- An earlier than scheduled deregulation of the oil industry will mean a substantial oil price increase, according to multisectoral task force chairman on power Raul Concepcion. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- Listed firm Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc is acquiring a majority stake in Pepsi-Cola Products Philippines. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

- New mining fields are expected to be unearthed in the Philippines as foreigners invest more money for gold and copper exploration, Environment and Natural Resources Secretary Victor Ramos said yesterday.
